events.title: Demo Coming Soon!
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972966/ed7dcdbaabbab8bef53d8cbcb36c1c27fa0431b9.png Hello, prospective wizards! 🧙‍♂️ For one week only, Ravenwood Academy: A Wizard101 Story is opening its doors for campus tours. events.title: Cora's Curiosities!
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972966/26ac270a5167c5a3383986b86c808116efcde7f3.png Need class supplies? Used textbooks? Obscure magic zines from Wysteria? Cora's Curiosities is the place for you. Special discounts for students of Ravenwood Academy!

events.title: The library reading room is finally ready for students! 📚
events.summary: The library reading room is finally ready for students! 📚It's quiet, spacious, and just steps away from all the knowledge you'll need to pass any exam. If you're serious about your magical education, you're likely to spend a lot of time here. #Wizard101 #RavenwoodAcademy

events.title: Study Spot Sneak Peek 2!
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972966/53336d616b19670b79c4ab204549ba69996cf1e7.png Hmm... Things are starting to form. Who knows what else you might uncover in this room? 🤔 There's one more step before this scene is fully revealed. Stay tuned!

events.title: Study Spot Sneak Peek!
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972966/5ff2908363f185f7949f5e20fcd43341e154a825.png Ravenwood Academy has some strong foundations. 📝 Stay tuned to see how we turn this environment into the best study spot on campus!

events.title: Meet Naya Coldbrook!
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972966/cf032ce849eb382e66fc300c7f28db8e9df95f48.png Naya Coldbrook's skill, talent, and determination have earned her the praise of Headmaster Ambrose himself. 🔮 Ancient incantations, obscure alchemy, rare manuscripts... she knows it all. A good study partner, if you can keep up with her!

events.title: Take a peek inside the Death School!
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972966/34b27a4fb6f3ada72195c5db50215dd8caa9aff8.jpg Think you can survive a lesson in the Death School? 💀 Wizard101 players can’t attend one of Professor Malistaire Drake’s lectures in the Death School. But YOU can. Caution: his pop quizzes are evil...

events.title: Meet Dalia Falmea!
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972966/b5617f41b0c3efc4d31791cf6ad5b5701683fe86.png She'll be the Professor of Fire Magic at the Ravenwood School of Magical Arts... someday. 🔥 Right now, Dalia Falmea's a third-year Fire Adept and the best friend a transfer wizard could hope to find.

events.title: Like Night and Day...
events.summary: Like Night & Day... 🌤️You might have walked these cobblestone paths, but never while the sun rises or the moon shines! See Ravenwood in a brand-new light in Ravenwood Academy: A Wizard101 Story!

events.title: Development Updates!
events.summary: Let's talk about development updates for Ravenwood Academy: A Wizard101 Story! 🪄 In addition, we'll show a walkthrough of the demo from PAX West 2025, narrated by the Narrative Director himself!

events.title: Play the New Exclusive Demo at PAX West!
events.summary: It's time for a lesson! 📖🪄Play the all-new Ravenwood Academy: A Wizard101 Story demo exclusively at PAX West in booth #733 from August 29th through September 1st.Everyone who plays through the demo will receive a FREE exclusive Ravenwood Academy branded light up lanyard and student ID card while supplies last. Please Note: This demo shows a look at the game in early development, things will continue to take shape as time passes and the game gets closer to launch!
